spans.s: डिंगर m. 1. A servant; 2. a cheat, a rogue; 3. a depraved man.
डिंडिम m. A kind of small drum, प्रियमभिसरस्येवं मुग्धे समाहतडिंडिमा Am.
डिंडी(डि)र m. 1. Cuttle-fish-bone considered to be the foam of the sea; 2. foam in general, चंदनस्यंदडिंडीरच्छलेन मलयाचलः Vikr.Ch.iv.4, 64.
डिंडी(डि)र m. 1. Cuttle-fish-bone considered to be the foam of the sea; 2. foam in general, चंदनस्यंदडिंडीरच्छलेन मलयाचलः Vikr.Ch.iv.4, 64.
डिंब m. 1. Affray, riot; 2. noise occasioned by terror; 3. a young child; 4. a globe, a ball.
डिंब-आहव m. petty warfare, an affray without weapons, M.v.95.
डिंब-युद्ध n. petty warfare, an affray without weapons, M.v.95.
डिंबिका f. 1. A libidinous woman; 2. a bubble.
डिंभ m. 1. A young child, Sak.vii.; 2. any young animal; 3. a fool, a block-head.
डिंभक m. (fem. ˚भिका) 1. a young child; 2. any young animal.
डीन n. The flight of a bird; (there are several varieties of it as उड्डीन, अवडीन, महाडीन, सुडीन, अभिडीन, संडीन &c., the special mode of flight being expressed by the word prefixed to डीन).
